title: The corkboard at year's end
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
arc: The Last Week of the Century
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The last night but one. Wood takes everything off the corkboard, looks at it on the bed, and pins it all back in the same places. The strip counts: nine things. The postcard, thumb side to the wall.

panels.composition: The bedroom. The corkboard, bare, pinholes. Everything on the bed. WOOD standing over it. BARNABY on the pillow.

image.prompt: a young man standing over a bed spread with pinned-up papers, a bare corkboard behind him full of pinholes, a small dog on the pillow, black and white, no words

panels.composition: On the bed: the crab flyer, the yearbook photo, the Timberline back page, the bus schedule, two postcards, the misfold, Gully's napkin, the mother's — no. Eight. And the note from the rack. Nine.

image.prompt: close on a bed spread with a flyer, a yearbook photo, a newspaper page, a bus schedule, two postcards, a folded misprinted booklet, a napkin and a small note, black and white, no words
image.notes: Nine things, Dec 1999, per objects.md plus the rack note and Gully's napkin.

panels.composition: Wood pinning them back, one by one, in the same holes.

image.prompt: a young man pinning papers back onto a corkboard one by one into the same holes, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The corkboard, restored. The needle-tower postcard: photo out, thumb side to the wall. The year ends the way it was pinned.

image.prompt: close on a restored corkboard with a postcard of a needle-shaped tower pinned photo-side out among other papers, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Nine things off, nine back. The postcard stays thumb-side to the wall.
